faqs.q: How are rewards credited on the BOBCARD Uni GoldX Credit Card?
faqs.a: Rewards are credited in the form of 24K digital gold. Eligible transactions on Amazon, Swiggy, Flipkart, and more than 200 voucher brands available through the Uni App earn 5% back as digital gold. Flight and hotel bookings made via the Uni App earn 7% back, while all UPI and offline merchant payments earn 1% back.

faqs.q: Can I use the rewards earned as digital gold?
faqs.a: Yes. The accumulated digital gold can be redeemed as cash or converted into a physical gold coin, subject to the redemption terms and conditions applicable at the time of redemption.

faqs.q: Does the card charge any annual or joining fee?
faqs.a: No. The BOBCARD Uni GoldX Credit Card is a lifetime-free credit card and does not have any joining fee or annual fee.

faqs.q: What is the benefit of having the card on the RuPay network?
faqs.a: The RuPay variant allows cardholders to link the credit card to supported UPI apps and make UPI payments directly using their credit card. Eligible UPI transactions also earn 1% back as 24K digital gold.

faqs.q: Is there any charge on international transactions?
faqs.a: The card comes with a zero foreign exchange markup fee, which means no additional foreign currency markup is charged on international transactions.

faqs.q: What happens if I do not pay my credit card bill on time?
faqs.a: If the outstanding balance is not paid by the due date, finance charges of 3.99% per month (47.88% per annum) may apply on the unpaid amount. In addition, late payment fees range from RS. 100 to Rs. 1,300 are charged based on the total outstanding balance.
